resources.string: You used your share today. Crew runs earn again tomorrow.
Today your crew runs earn with your own energy.

A crew run (2 or more running together in the crew room) earns with crew stamina instead of your own energy. Crew stamina is the energy maximum of every sharing member\'s shoes added up, plus the crew level bonus. Each share is crew stamina divided by the number of sharing members.
When your share runs out, crew runs earn nothing for the rest of the day. They do not switch to your own energy.
Members who joined before today and ran in the last 7 days share it. Today\'s crew stamina stays as it was first set today. Shoe or crew level changes count from tomorrow.
Solo runs and flash runs still earn with your own energy.
Crew runs earn with crew stamina.
Your crew stamina share is used up, so this run earns nothing.
You do not share crew stamina today, so this run earns with your own energy.
The level rises with the distance run together in the crew room (2 or more), counted for each runner.
Finish your first crew run to reach Lv.1.
